description: Whether an action holds: it records while its control is down and finishes on release. Only pushToTalk and pushToTalkDraft hold. Holding is a property of the action, never of the control (DESIGN v2.7 C, HK-004). Input is an action descriptor; expected is a bool.
function: Action.isHoldAction — input an action descriptor, expected a bool
